remarks: An upstairs loft and bright, connected living spaces give this newly built end-unit townhome the flexibility to fit your day. At Caspian Villas, approximately 1,630 square feet bring together three upstairs bedrooms, two upstairs bathrooms and a main-level powder room. White cabinetry and contemporary finishes provide a clean backdrop for the open kitchen, dining and living areas, whether you are hosting dinner or settling in after work. The loft makes room for a dedicated workspace, movie nights or a favorite reading chair without giving up a bedroom. A patio, indoor laundry, central heating and air conditioning, and an attached two-car garage round out the everyday conveniences. Washingto
